Therefore all composite n (which have prime factors 2 or 3) work, while prime n do not. The solution is all composite positive integers n.

For each positive integer k ≤ n, the number of regular hexagons of side length k whose vertices lie on the triangular lattice points inside and on the large regular hexagon of side length n is equal to the number of lattice points in a regular hexagon of side length n−k, which is 3(n−k)² + 3(n−k) + 1. 设轴向坐标系以正六边形中心为原点，基向量 $e_1=(1,0)$，$e_2=\left(\frac12,\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)$。则格点坐标为 $P(i,j)=i\,e_1+j\,e_2$，其中 $i,j\in\mathbb Z$。

对于边长为 $k$（$k\in\mathbb Z_{>0}$）且与外六边形同向（朝向1）的正六边形，其中心为格点 $C=(x,y)=P(i,j)$，六个顶点坐标为
\[
\begin{aligned}
V_1 &= (x+k,\;y),\\
V_2 &= (x,\;y+k),\\
V_3 &= (x-k,\;y+k),\\
V_4 &= (x-k,\;y),\\
V_5 &= (x,\;y-k),\\
V_6 &= (x+k,\;y-k).
\end{aligned}
\]
等价地，在轴向坐标下顶点为 $(i+k,j),\;(i,j+k),\;(i-k,j+k),\;(i-k,j),\;(i,j-k),\;(i+k,j-k)$。
